name: Uniforms
overview: Scripture reveals that uniforms serve distinct roles within God's order, as seen in the specific garments prescribed for Aaron and his sons to minister as priests, emphasizing holiness and separation in service (Exodus 28:1). The distinction in clothing also reflects God's design for gender roles, forbidding men and women from wearing each other's garments as an abomination (Deuteronomy 22:5). These instructions highlight the importance of appropriate attire in worship and community identity, underscoring reverence and obedience to God's commands.
